bio: Built in 1795, Oakley Hall Hotel has a distinguished past. Formerly owned by the Bramston family, close friends of Jane Austen, it is mentioned fondly in Austen's letters to her sister Cassandra at the turn of the 19th Century.  Jane Austen lived in the neighbouring village of Steventon until she was 25 years old, and during this time she wrote some of her most beloved and remembered novels, including Pride & Prejudice.  Afternoon Tea includes finger sandwiches, home made scones with clotted cream and jam, home made cakes and a choice of tea, coffee or soft drink.
